paper_id: Differentiable and Scalable Generative Adversarial Models for Data Imputation
title: Differentiable and Scalable Generative Adversarial Models for Data Imputation
motivation: GAN imputation性能好但训练代价极高，大规模数据下计算不可行
problem_framing: GAN基于JS散度在支撑不重叠时梯度消失，且需估算保证精度的最小样本量
key_insight: 利用最优传输理论设计掩码Sinkhorn散度使GAN可微，从而可解析推导精度保证下的最小训练样本数
method_signature: SCIS = DIM(MS散度损失) + SSE(最小样本量估计)
evaluation_criteria: RMSE、训练时间、训练样本率、下游预测AUC/MAE
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 几乎所有GAN imputation算法仅在MCAR假设下有效，复杂缺失机制下效果受限
evidence_for_taste: JS divergence fails in the case that the supports have non-overlapping
the gradients of JS are 0 almost everywhere
a smaller value of ε signifies a lower user-tolerated error
more training samples the imputation method requires
the more training samples the higher imputation accuracy
SCIS-GAIN shows a negligible decrease in imputation accuracy
the less the initial sample size the larger the variance
thinking_moves: 把vanishing gradient问题归因于JS散度理论缺陷，而非实现问题
用最优传输理论(Sinkhorn)替代JS散度提供连续可微的替代
可微性不仅解决梯度问题，还开启了理论样本量分析的通路
先在初始样本上验证MS散度，再分析精度保证下的扩展需求
